Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
jneb...@www.esi.us.es (Jaime Nebrera Herrera) writes:
> Hi, I want to know if Crucher's ( Brujah's Vampire ) special ability is a
>strike ( The card reads " he may burn one blood to have a dodge once per
>combat ..." more or less).

Crusher's ability counts as a strike.
In fact, all dodges are strikes (whether the card says so or not).
This is official (errata/ruling/whatever).
